title: SYNTHESIZE / REVISE cell output (stub) — surgical patch, not regeneration
description: Given diff context (what failed, what the probe found, what to harden), patches the existing task. Triggered by harden (CALIBRATE/QA-PROBE) or revise (QA GATE).

reason.description: quotes the deterministic verdict that routed here

patch.description: surgical edits; each names the file and the nature of the change

regenerated.description: must be false except for explicitly regenerable artifacts; SYNTHESIZE patches, never rebuilds from scratch

preserves_identity.description: patch must not change task_identity (source x lang x scope); else it's a new task
